title: Web Hosting Plans Terms of Service: Number of Plans and One Live Plan per Primary Domain
content:
**Section 1 — Plans a customer may hold.** A customer may hold any number of Web Hosting Plans plans; there is no per-customer limit on the number of plans. Each plan is billed and renewed on its own term.

**Section 2 — One live plan per primary domain.** A new plan may be ordered for a primary domain only when no other plan of any customer for that primary domain is in status provisioning, active, suspended or cancel-pending. The test is made against Harborline's hosting records before the order is placed, and it compares the primary domain of the order with the primary domain recorded on every existing plan, whichever customer holds it.

**Section 3 — Further websites.** Additional websites belong on an existing plan within that plan's websites allowance rather than on a second plan for the same domain.

**Section 2 applied (illustrations).**

| Another plan with the same primary domain | Section 2 stands in the way of the new order |
|---|---|
| in status provisioning | Yes |
| in status active | Yes |
| in status suspended | Yes |
| in status cancel-pending | Yes |
| held by a different customer, in status active | Yes |
| none of the four statuses above on any plan for that domain | No |

*Q: A customer already has an active plan for one domain and wants a second plan for a different primary domain — does Section 1 or 2 limit this?* A: No. Section 1 sets no limit on the number of plans, and Section 2 concerns only plans for the same primary domain.
